title: Identity and product mosaic

location.extent: Complete published video; PNG is one poster frame

slide_intent: Compare ingredients in one frame so consistency can be judged across different kinds of content.
strategic_value: A modular mosaic can show how Wise’s type, green, imagery and functional symbols belong together.
demonstration: Rounded tiles change through logos, colored type, tapestry textures, illustrations, currency symbols, flags, transaction lists and product photographs.
practical_value: Test whether a new component shares enough visual cues with the existing family.

content_islands.name: Tile framework
content_islands.spec: Arrange differently sized rounded tiles into a compact two-row composition.

content_islands.name: Changing specimens
content_islands.spec: Cycle the contents while maintaining clear tile boundaries and contrasting color fields.

reference_purposes.Expression: Rounded tiles change through logos, colored type, tapestry textures, illustrations, currency symbols, flags, transaction lists and product photographs.
reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates a comparative arrangement of brand and product components.
